status: Proposed module architecture; internal imports acyclic and all external import paths checked against pinned dependencies. No Lean files implemented or compiled by this audit.
import_policy: Definitions remain canonical and light: Geometry.Euclidean/Planes/FlatMeasure; Tangent.Blowup/Defs; Uniform.Defs/Moments/Flatness. Do not reexport Uniform.Defs from Tangent.Defs.
Use the pure closed-ball UnitUniform predicate; only Uniform.GMTAdapters crosses to FormalizingGMT.MarstrandTheorem. Some theorem files also import its exact reused theorems explicitly.
Tangent.Compactness is independent of all uniqueness-at-infinity work. Tangent.Blowdown depends only on tangent closure and dilation invariance.
Tangent.ScalingOrbit precedes Uniform.DimensionReduction and Uniform.FlatPseudotangent; it does not import the final pseudotangent theorem.
FlatAtInfinity.Basic -> TraceData/SupportIdentity -> TraceLimits -> TraceIdentities -> TraceRigidity -> FlatAtInfinity.Rigidity is one-directional.
MomentEstimates contains the finite Taylor remainder. MomentFeatures depends on it, and MomentExpansion depends on MomentFeatures; do not put the finite remainder only in MomentExpansion.
Generic GaussianQuadraticForms is independent of uniform moment definitions; FlatMoments is its outward adapter to those definitions.
Mathlib import sets are valid topic-level candidates, not claims of proof-complete minimal imports; any further tactic/proof imports should be added at the use site.

statement_boundary_refinements.decision: Core theorem in Tangent.Algebra covers blow-up composition, scalar and isometry covariance. Flatness preservation is the existing lem:plane-scaling wrapper in Tangent.FlatScaling; uniformity preservation is in Uniform.Scaling. Remove lem:plane-scaling as a core algebra prerequisite to avoid a file cycle.

The general fourth moment does not depend on the flat-measure specialized lemma. Prove it from stdGaussian APIs in Analysis.GaussianQuadraticForms; FlatMoments imports it and the general even-moment formula.

This old bundled label splits across Geometry.FlatMeasure, Tangent.Defs and Uniform.Defs. The legacy external label mapping selects Tangent.Defs for tangent-closure uses; concrete files explicitly import other definitions they use.

shared_data_types.name: Euclidean / Plane / IsFlat
shared_data_types.requirement: Reuse parent canonical definitions; Plane m n retains existing argument order. Supply subtype inclusion, orthogonal projection, finrank, normalized flat measure and its unit-ball mass.

shared_data_types.name: dimensionalBlowup
shared_data_types.requirement: Keep exact existing lowercase-u name and arguments (m) (mu) (x) (r). Define with direct map r⁻¹ • (z-x); GMT blowUpMap equality should be rfl.

shared_data_types.name: IsUnitUniform / IsConical
shared_data_types.requirement: Use pure regularity/origin/exact closed-ball law; m=0 allowed in definition. Moment and reduction theorems assume 0<m. IsConical is exact equality of every positive dimensionalBlowup at 0.

shared_data_types.name: gaussianMoment
shared_data_types.requirement: Retain scalar definition for every raw measure, k, s and tuple, independently of integrability. Continuous multilinear packaging is downstream.

shared_data_types.name: gaussianMomentForm
shared_data_types.requirement: ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Euclidean n) ℝ. Package only under an explicit polynomial-growth/integrability hypothesis or use a documented zero fallback; symmetry is a theorem, not a quotient type. Prefer an explicit GaussianGrowth witness to avoid depending on Uniform.Defs.

shared_data_types.name: MomentCoefficients
shared_data_types.requirement: Coefficient data (k j : ℕ) → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin k => Euclidean n) ℝ, plus a separate IsMomentExpansion predicate containing symmetry and operator-little-o expansions. Existence gives a coherent family; degree vanishing and support identities stay separate theorems. Do not silently choose unrelated forms in every theorem.

shared_data_types.name: PolynomialFeatures
shared_data_types.requirement: Degree truncation N; Euclidean index Σ k : Fin N, (Fin (k.val+1) → Fin n); weights sqrt(2^degree/degree!), coordinate block projections, feature pairing formula.

shared_data_types.name: Rigidity data
shared_data_types.requirement: Pass nu, positive m, a unit-uniform witness, plane V, flat blow-down witness and one coherent coefficient family. Normal b : Vᗮ; omega : V →L[ℝ] V →L[ℝ] Vᗮ with symmetry; adjusted form : V →L[ℝ] V →L[ℝ] ℝ with symmetry.

shared_data_types.name: Gaussian probability
shared_data_types.requirement: Reuse ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian V directly, plus stdGaussian_map and stdGaussian_eq_map_pi_orthonormalBasis. No new Gaussian distribution definition.

shared_data_types.name: Bilinear trace
shared_data_types.requirement: Riesz-represent symmetric continuous bilinear forms as self-adjoint endomorphisms; use LinearMap.trace and prove the orthonormal diagonal sum. Coefficient restriction must be a typed map on V or Vᗮ.

shared_data_types.name: flatnessEnergy / flatness
shared_data_types.requirement: Keep pure existing scalar definitions; state the cutoff hypotheses in theorems or a separate Cutoff predicate. All minimizer arguments require m<=n. This data file must not import Moments.
